news.title: Annual Celebration of St. Mark
news.content: Join us for our annual celebration honoring St. Mark the Evangelist. This year we will have special liturgy, traditional music, and community fellowship.

news.title: Community Outreach Program
news.content: Our church continues its commitment to serving the community through outreach programs, food distribution, and assistance to those in need.

news.title: Youth Group Meeting
news.content: The youth group will meet this Friday at 6:30 PM for fellowship, games, and spiritual discussion. All young people are welcome to attend.

news.title: New Church Music Initiative
news.content: We are launching a new initiative to preserve and teach traditional Ethiopian Orthodox church music. Choir practice begins every Thursday at 7:00 PM.

news.title: Prayer and Fasting Observance
news.content: We observe prayer and fasting days throughout the year following our church calendar. These times help us grow in spiritual discipline and devotion.

news.title: Weekly Bible Study Classes
news.content: Bible study classes are held every Wednesday at 7:00 PM. We explore scripture together and discuss its meaning in our daily lives.
